newsitem.title: USA: New York insurer, cancer center sign deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: New York insurer, cancer center sign deal - WSJ.

text.p: New York State health insurer Empire Blue Cross & Blue Shield has signed a contract with Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center, a prominent cancer facility that had previously shunned managed care, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the insurer had secretly negotiated a contract with the insurer during the last few months.
Under its terms, the center would cut its rates by as much as 30 percent in exchange for a greater flow of new patients.
In January, the U.S. state will lift regulations that control the prices that hospitals can charge and insurers can pay.
